concepts.label: Wallet identity
concepts.decision: Keep cryptographic key control, directory identity, provider account binding and membership separate.

concepts.label: Provider authority
concepts.decision: A verified-operation reference is evidence of one checked call, not an issuer or authority root. Reuse it for evidence; separately describe trusted issuer/key lifecycle.

concepts.label: Canonical service
concepts.decision: One canonical service owns authority across several access points and launched instances. Do not identify it with a process, URL or ServiceInstance record.

concepts.label: Service instance
concepts.decision: Reuse the v0.9.0 descriptive instance vocabulary. Discovery and local registration establish no ownership, trust or permission.

concepts.label: Access point
concepts.decision: A verified service route is distinct from a person contact interface. A secS access-point binding links a route to canonical authority without granting access.

concepts.label: Protected resource reference
concepts.decision: Reuse owner/kind/ID reference vocabulary and add an explicit verified canonical-service binding in the authorization profile. Owner and namespace scope are not automatically that binding.

concepts.label: Resource instance
concepts.decision: The existing draft models physical/compute/virtual resources, offers and capacity. Do not force a Task or permission target into that shape. A protected-object reference may refer to such a resource or to any supported domain record.

concepts.label: Resource type
concepts.decision: Reuse namespaced domain class identities. A shared authorization metamodel selects types; it does not replace Work, hospitality or inventory semantics with one superclass.

concepts.label: Authorization containment relation
concepts.decision: Map canonical CONTAINS to runtime HAS_CHILD using the provider contract; CONTAINS_WORK is distinct Arena membership. Use the actual named relation and installed evaluator. Semantic subclassing and browsing groups confer no containment authority.

concepts.label: Operation
concepts.decision: Map immutable semantic operation IDs and exact effect contracts. DevGraph operations.json supplies its catalog; receiver opcodes, URLs and UI group labels remain separate.

concepts.label: Resource selector
concepts.decision: Objects, Descendants and All select resources under explicit rules. Existing ScopeRef identifies an owner-scoped namespace; it is not the secS scope algebra.

concepts.label: Permission rule
concepts.decision: Bind operation, resource selector, conditions and any paired source/destination requirements. A policy reference or ontology record grants no authority.

concepts.label: Provider grant
concepts.decision: Describe the existing secS provider-signed grant without inventing a second credential producer or treating its ontology description as a valid grant.

concepts.label: Holder credential
concepts.decision: Describe finite equal-or-narrower same-Wallet use of a verified current grant. Keep storage/backup and signed runtime schemas owned by Wallet Core and secS.

concepts.label: Call presentation
concepts.decision: An exact-call proof is distinct from the grant, credential and receiver verification evidence. Current assignment, replay and revocation checks remain runtime requirements.

concepts.label: Credential preset
concepts.decision: Reuse v0.10.0 terms. Recipes suggest a draft and preserve exact revisions; editing a recipe never changes an issued grant.

concepts.label: Organizational seat
concepts.decision: Reuse canonical Seats and retain the draft ScopedPost mapping as related. Draft PostAssignment currently differs in occupant constraints. Appointment, reporting lines and classification confer no permission.

concepts.label: Exact revision evidence
concepts.decision: Reuse exact revision and approval evidence concepts. Signed provider review remains the authority boundary; a website display or schema validation is not approval.
